title: Molecular docking study of frequently used food additives for selected targets depending on the chromosomal abnormalities they cause.
authors: Okus, Fatma; Yuzbasioglu, Deniz; Unal, Fatma
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接评估食品添加剂与ATM/p53蛋白及DNA的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法为常规对接，深度有限。
abstract: Food additives (FAs) (flavor enhancers, sweeteners, etc.) protect foods during storage and transportation, making them attractive to consumers. Today, while the desire to access natural foods is increasing, the chemicals added to foods have started to be questioned. In this respect, genotoxicity tests have gained importance. Studies show that some food additives may have genotoxic risks. Previous studies carried out in our laboratory also revealed genotoxic effects of Monopotassium glutamate (MPG), Monosodium glutamate (MSG), Magnesium diglutamate (MDG) as flavor enhancers; Potassium benzoate (PB), Potassium sorbate (PS), Sodium benzoate (SB), Sodium sorbate (SS) as preservatives; Acesulfame potassium (ACE-K), Xylitol (XYL) as sweeteners. In this study, we determined the interactions of these food additives with ATM and p53 proteins, which are activated in the cell due to genotoxic effects, and with DNA by employing the molecular docking method for the first time. Among the food additives, SB (-4.307) for ATM, XYL (-4.629) for p53, and XYL (-4.927) for DNA showed the highest affinity. Therefore, flexible docking (IFD) scores were determined for SB, XYL, and MDG from flavor enhancers. The potential binding modes of the food additives to target molecules' possible inhibition mechanisms were determined by molecular docking. Thus, new information was obtained to show how these additives cause chromosomal abnormalities.
abstract_zh: 食品添加剂（FAs）（增味剂、甜味剂等）在储存和运输过程中保护食品，使其对消费者具有吸引力。如今，随着对天然食品需求的增加，添加到食品中的化学物质开始受到质疑。在这方面，遗传毒性试验变得尤为重要。研究表明，一些食品添加剂可能具有遗传毒性风险。我们实验室先前的研究也揭示了增味剂中的谷氨酸单钾（MPG）、谷氨酸单钠（MSG）、谷氨酸二镁（MDG）；防腐剂中的苯甲酸钾（PB）、山梨酸钾（PS）、苯甲酸钠（SB）、山梨酸钠（SS）；以及甜味剂中的安赛蜜钾（ACE-K）、木糖醇（XYL）具有遗传毒性效应。在本研究中，我们首次采用分子对接方法确定了这些食品添加剂与ATM和p53蛋白（因遗传毒性效应在细胞中被激活）以及DNA的相互作用。在食品添加剂中，SB（-4.307）对ATM、XYL（-4.629）对p53以及XYL（-4.927）对DNA表现出最高的亲和力。因此，确定了SB、XYL以及增味剂中的MDG的柔性对接（IFD）得分。通过分子对接确定了食品添加剂与靶分子潜在结合模式及其可能的抑制机制。由此获得了新信息，以展示这些添加剂如何导致染色体异常。
